content.text: Everyone, take a look at this beautiful snowy scene. Mia says she wants to go to Japan.
@Vicky Look, the night view here is truly dreamy!
If we go to Japan, we can also enjoy such kaiseki cuisine, which is definitely worth the money.
I'm afraid I can't afford to go! Look at my balance.
@小白 I think Changbai Mountain is also a good choice, and the cost is relatively reasonable.
@Dawei, I also find the barbecue at Changbai Mountain very appealing.
@Fat Tiger However, there are too many people on Changbai Mountain, so it might not be easy to take good photos.
@小白 Japan is indeed expensive, but if you stay at the hotel in picture 9, the view is amazing.

@Vicky I see the budget is seriously overrun, so let's consider Changbai Mountain first.

@Old Zhang If everyone has decided, then I'll reluctantly accept it.

Alright, then it's decided—we're going to Changbai Mountain. The flight tickets are already booked!
Look at this scenery of Tianchi Lake on Changbai Mountain, isn't it very attractive?

@Old Zhang It is indeed beautiful, but I'm still a bit hesitant about crowded places.
@Mia Actually, we could go during the off-season when there are fewer tourists.
Besides the scenery, there's also this barbecue—just thinking about it makes my mouth water.

But look, this crowded tourist spot is really a bit worrying.
@Mia, this is indeed a bit scary, but we can avoid the peak times or visit some lesser-known attractions.
@Vicky is right, and we can make plans in advance to avoid crowded places.
Overall, I think Changbai Mountain is quite appealing, especially considering our budget.
@Old Zhang Yes, and this trip can be more flexible without worrying too much about the cost.
That puts my mind at ease, looking forward to this trip.
Alright, I'm starting to look forward to it too, thinking about taking some nice photos.
Alright, it's settled then. Let's plan it out properly and make sure we have a great time.
Take a look at the flight prices for these two places, what do you think?
@Old Zhang, it's true that Japan has become much more expensive, but if you stay at the hotel in Figure 9, it might still be worth considering.
@Vicky I also think the hotel in picture 9 is nice, but the budget is a bit tight.
@Old Zhang, domestic airfare prices are more affordable, so I'm leaning towards traveling domestically.
I agree with Xiao Bai, the temptation of barbecue is also not to be overlooked!
I've done a simple analysis of the budget. Please take a look and see if any adjustments are needed.
@David, have you considered hotel expenses like those in Figure 9 in your budget?
@David If we can stay in Picture 9, I think the budget could be reconsidered.
It seems there are still some differences of opinion regarding the accommodation. Let's take a closer look at the specific situation in Figure 9.
This hotel has a pleasant environment and convenient transportation.
@David It does look very comfortable, but we need to consider the budget more carefully.
@David, I think a comfortable hotel like the one in Picture 9 can make the journey more enjoyable.
@Fat Tiger If we could stay in this kind of hotel, Changbai Mountain would be a good choice.
Alright, since everyone is interested in the hotel in Figure 9, we can look into how to adjust the budget to make this plan work.
Look at the distance from this hotel to the scenic area; the transportation is very convenient.
@Old Zhang Indeed, the distance isn't far, but the luxury of the hotel itself is the key factor.
@Mia The floor-to-ceiling window and bathtub in Picture 9 are both excellent; I think they're worth considering.
@Vicky But I can't afford the budget for a luxury hotel; we still need to find a balance.
@小白 You can adjust other expenses, such as dining and activities, to focus on experiencing the hotel.
@David Agreed, the hotel experience was the highlight of this trip, and we can save on other aspects.
This is the previous voting result, we have already decided on Changbai Mountain.
@Old Zhang Since the decision has been made, let's see how to optimize the budget.
@Mia We can consider sharing a room to reduce accommodation costs.
@Vicky Sharing a room is a great idea; it can significantly reduce expenses.
@小白 If everyone agrees, I think it could work.
@David I'm fine with it, as long as everyone is comfortable.
The vote result is 4:2, so let's proceed as planned.
@Old Zhang Since the votes are already decided, let's look forward to the trip to Changbai Mountain.
Look at this, there are also nice places in Changbai Mountain.
@Mia Indeed, from this perspective, Changbai Mountain is also quite appealing.
@Mia Those forests look really beautiful, looking forward to taking photos there.
The flight tickets are all set, everyone get ready!
@Old Zhang That's great, everything is finally confirmed.
Now we're just waiting to set off, looking forward to the beautiful scenery of Changbai Mountain.
Although I was a bit reluctant at first, I hope to have a pleasant journey.
@Mia, staying at that five-star hotel would probably make you even more satisfied.
Yes, once we get there, we must try some delicious barbecue.
Barbecue is a must! But I might have to keep an eye on my spending.
@Xiao Bai No problem, we can share together, and the budget won't be exceeded.
